SELECT a.id AS id, a.NAME AS NAME, a.person_type AS personType, a.gender AS gender, jso.office_name AS organization, pa.position_name AS workShop, pl.prod_line_name AS prodLine, wg.work_group_name AS teamGroup, a.job_type AS workType, a.safety_helmet_id AS safetyHelmetId, a.personnel_status AS personnelStatus, a.safety_education AS safetyEducation, a.identity_card AS identityCard, a.phone_number AS phoneNumber, a.helmet_returned AS helmetReturned, a.departure_type AS departureType, a.departure_reason AS departureReason, a.departure_date AS departureDate, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_date AS createDate, a.update_by AS updateBy, a.update_date AS updateDate, a.remarks AS remarks, a.STATUS AS STATUS, f.id AS workerArchiveId, a.company AS officeCode, a.department AS positionArchiveId, a.team AS workGroupId, a.prod_line AS prodLineId FROM swm_person a LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive pa ON a.department = pa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line pl ON a.prod_line = pl.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON a.team = wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN swm_work_type backup_wt ON a.job_type = backup_wt.work_type_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office jso ON a.company = jso.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_worker f ON a.identity_card = f.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fms_worker fw2 WHERE fw2.identity_code = f.identity_code AND fw2.create_date > f.create_date) WHERE a.personnel_status = '1' AND a.STATUS = '0'
AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')
AND a.person_type IN
#{personType}

SELECT a.id AS id, a.name AS name, a.person_type AS personType, a.gender AS gender, o.office_name AS organization, p.position_name AS workShop, fpl.prod_line_name AS prodLine, wg.work_group_name AS teamGroup, f.work_type AS workType, a.identity_card AS identityCard, -- 关联表的ID字段 2025/06/24 Shawn 添加 f.id AS workerArchiveId, -- 工人档案ID o.office_code AS officeCode, -- 组织编码 p.id AS positionArchiveId, -- 车间ID wg.id AS workGroupId, -- 班组ID fpl.id AS prodLineId -- 产线ID FROM swm_person a LEFT JOIN fms_worker f ON a.identity_card = f.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office o ON f.office_code = o.office_code AND o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive p ON f.work_shop_code = p.id AND p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON f.work_group_id = wg.id LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line fpl ON fpl.id = wg.prod_line_id WHERE a.identity_card = #{identityCard} AND a.personnel_status = '1' LIMIT 1
SELECT color FROM swm_helmet_subitem WHERE `key` = #{key} AND status = '0' ORDER BY create_date DESC LIMIT 1
